minutes.headline: Personnel Committee finished rating the PAC manager job and approved the amended job description.
minutes.summary: The committee approved two sets of prior minutes with corrections. It then amended and approved the PAC manager job description and scored the position on the rating grid. The total fell well short of the next grade bracket. The committee set its next meeting for the 24th to start work on outliers.

votes.motion: Approve the September 26, 2023 meeting minutes, as amended to record the votes in the new business section.
Approve the October 4 meeting minutes with a similar amendment recording the new business votes.
Accept the PAC manager job description as amended.

budget_items.what_was_said: The job description lets the manager act as purchasing agent for supplies or services under a stated threshold, following procurement procedures.

budget_items.topic: Rating grid total and grade bracket
budget_items.what_was_said: The PAC manager's total came in below the next grade bracket. Rating changes under discussion would not have moved it up a grade.

The manager said the position is currently grade 11 at the top step and is the lowest-graded department head. The manager also works about 28 hours a week and often goes over, and an exempt status would mean unpaid extra hours.
The spreadsheet lists the current grade, the consultant's proposed grade and the committee's grade for the PAC manager. The FY24 rates would be needed to see the money effect.

Level of experience stays at degree three, with a note that it could be a four, as an outlier.

what_happened.line: The committee voted to accept the PAC manager job description as amended.
The committee scored the PAC manager position on the rating grid; the total fell below the next grade bracket, and the rating changes discussed would not have raised it a grade.
The PAC manager position was marked as an outlier to revisit, with the experience level kept at degree three and a note that it could be a four.
The PAC manager said the position is at grade 11, top step, the lowest-graded department head, and works about 28 hours a week, often more.
The next meeting was set for Tuesday the 24th at 5:30 to begin the outlier review, with the spreadsheet renamed as phase one.

why_it_matters: The grade assigned to the PAC manager job sets pay for a town department head, and this rating grid is the mechanism that would decide whether the grade changes.
The spreadsheet compares current, consultant-proposed and committee grades, but the money effect cannot be seen until FY24 rates are applied, so any cost to the town is not yet known.
watch_next: Personnel Committee meeting on Tuesday the 24th at 5:30, in person if a room is found, to review outliers including the PAC manager position.
The FY24 rates needed to show the money effect of the spreadsheet's grade comparison.
